raw_text: Tribune India reports that tractor convoys began assembling at Punjab border points as early as 3 AM, hours before mainstream media coverage began. Farmer unions used Telegram groups to coordinate convoy routes, share supply chain logistics, and plan barricade bypass strategies. The mobilization represents the largest farmers' protest movement since the 2020-21 agitation against the now-repealed farm laws.
clean_text: Tractor convoys assembled at Punjab borders from 3 AM, hours before mainstream coverage. Telegram used for convoy coordination and logistics. Largest farmer mobilization since 2020-21.
